name: PsiQuantum
status: Remains venture-funded with no public listing announced; its $1.5B Series E (May 2026, $10.5B valuation) stands, and the U.S. Department of Commerce finalized a $100M CHIPS Act R&D award on September 8, 2026. It also holds a $125M DARPA agreement signed July 22, 2026.

name: EigenQ
note: Quantum-resilient security & trusted infrastructure · defense focus
status: EigenQ and Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp (Nasdaq: SVAQ) publicly filed their Form S-4 on September 28, 2026 for a ~$3.0B pro forma combination, after a confidential draft in August. They target a Q4 2026 Nasdaq listing as "EIGQ," subject to SEC effectiveness and shareholder approval.

name: Terra Quantum
status: Signed a definitive business combination agreement with Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp 1 (Nasdaq: AXIN) on May 25-26, 2026 at a $3.5 billion equity valuation, using a two-step Swiss PubCo/Cayman merger structure. PubCo and Terra Quantum still intend to file the Form F-4 registration statement.
latestFunding: SPAC deal at $3.5B equity valuation, announced May 2026

name: SeeQC
note: Superconducting digital quantum control chips & foundry · US/UK/Italy
status: SeeQC and Allegro Merger Corp mutually terminated their SPAC merger via a Settlement, Termination and Release Agreement effective August 25, 2026 (SeeQC owes Allegro up to $2M expenses plus $6M in stock if a trigger transaction closes). SeeQC continues pursuing its own Form S-1 IPO on Nasdaq.

name: Naoris Quantum Protocol
note: Post-quantum blockchain security & decentralized trust infrastructure
status: Continues its Form 1-A Reg A+ offering (Amendment No. 2 filed September 22, 2026) to sell up to 6,000,000 Class A shares at $4.00 (max $24M, min $15M to close), applying to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market as "QDY". The offering will not close unless Nasdaq listing approval is secured.

name: TuringQ
note: Photonic quantum hardware · China · pursuing STAR Market listing
